entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie, I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I'd like to start a return for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 19 days ago. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It works perfectly fine, but it's just not for me. I thought I'd use it more. I know it's been a little while, so I was hoping we could work something out. Maybe a partial credit?
I understand. Let me just take a look at the return policy for this item.
Okay, I've checked the policy, and you're all set. Our standard return window is 90 days from the date of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? I was worried I was too late and that the policy would be much stricter. That's great news.

Nope, you're well within the timeframe. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label and instructions to the email address on file. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
That was much easier than I expected. Thank you very much, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
